_what: Minimal RSC-flight fragments of REAL cached sephora.com.tr PDPs, for tests/test_rsc_flight_price.py (UNIT B1, ENABLE_RSC_FLIGHT_PRICE). sephora.com.tr is a Next.js App Router in front of SFCC; the price is NOT in JSON-LD/microdata/OG — it is carried in the React Server Component flight stream (self.__next_f) as an escaped \"price\":<int>,\"currency\":\"TRY\" adjacency. Every title, og:title, og:url, amount, currency and variant fragment below is copied VERBATIM out of the cached bytes; only the <head> boilerplate and the choice to keep the top-level price adjacency plus three real variant decoys are authored.
_corpus: _proof/global/html/ + _proof/global/_corpus_cachemap.json (429 files). Rows for these three PDPs live in _proof/global/middle_east_non_gulf.jsonl (host www.sephora.com.tr).
_minor_unit_convention_PINNED: The flight price is denominated in MAJOR currency units (whole TRY), NOT minor units. B4's open question, resolved against the visible shelf price in each cached row's price_text_raw: armani flight price=5050 vs visible '5.050,00 TL'; bleu 8400 vs '8.400,00 TL'; kayali 2090 vs '2.090,00 TL'. So the flight integer is used as-is with NO division by 100.

sephora_com_tr_armani_si_flight_try.html.measured: flight top-level price 5050 TRY (B4, 3/3); visible '5.050,00 TL'
sephora_com_tr_armani_si_flight_try.html.kept: the page <title>/og:title/og:url verbatim, plus ONE self.__next_f flight chunk holding the verbatim top-level \"price\":5050,\"currency\":\"TRY\" adjacency followed by three real variant decoys (2050, 5050, 8650 TRY) so first-occurrence selection is genuinely tested against later variant prices
